summary: Mimico-by-the-Lake Secondary Plan (OPA 197) was adopted by City Council in July 2013. General appeals and two site specific appeals were subsequently filed (PL130885). The proceedings were divided into 3 phases. Following the first phase on the general appeals, pursuant to the Decision of the Ontario Municipal Board issued March 31, 2016, OPA 197, as modified with approval of Council, came into full force and effect subject to the two site specific appeals and determination as to a lakeside street in Precinct B. 1026046 Ontario Limited is the owner of 2491 Lake Shore Boulevard West and the appellant of the site specific appeal relating to that property. Since December 2014, the parties participated in various Board assisted mediation sessions respecting this appeal. The purpose of this report is to provide a status update and seek direction from City Council for proceeding before the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT) (formerly the Ontario Municipal Board). City Planning has been involved in preparation of this report.
decided: City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the Confidential Recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of only Confidential Recommendations 1, 2 and 3 in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (July 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1, including Confidential Appendix C and Confidential Schedules A, B and C to the report (July 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential. The Confidential Recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council. Confidential Recommendations 1, 2 and 3 only are now public, as follows: 1.
